newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Bengang Steel completes 460 mln B share IPO.
newsitem.headline: China Bengang Steel completes 460 mln B share IPO.

text.p: China's Bengang Steel Plates Co Ltd has completed its initial public offering (IPO) of 460 million B shares, raising about one billion yuan, an official at the lead domestic underwriter said on Friday.

The IPO, priced at HK$2.38 (2.547 yuan) per share, was launched on Tuesday and finalised on Thursday, the official at Shenyin & Wanguo Securities told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
All the B shares were issued to foreign institutions, largely fund managers, in private placement, the official said.
The B shares are slated for listing on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in early July, he said.
The IPO carried a P/E ratio of 8.0 times based on fully diluted 1996 per-share net profit of 0.318 yuan under international accounting standards, according to Bengang's B share prospectus.
ABN-AMRO Hoare Govett was the global coordinator for the issue.
Bengang also planned to follow the B share IPO with a 120 million domestic currency A share offer.
Both the A and B shares are for listing on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange.
Bengang will use proceeds to expand and renovate steel making facilities, the prospectus said.
Bengang forecast net earnings of 390 million yuan for 1997 based on international accounting standards, the official said.
Bengang posted net profits of 361.97 million yuan for 1996 and 201.52 million yuan for 1995.
Sales reached 4.98 billion yuan last year against 4.85 billion yuan for 1995, the prospectus said without giving a forecast.
Bengang, based in Benxi city in northeastern Liaoning province, has an annual hot-rolled steel production capacity of 2.2 million tonnes, it said.
Most of Bengang's steel products are sold domestically, with the rest exported to Southeast Asia, the prospectus said, adding Bengang holds 14.52 percent of China's market share.
Bengang is 57.25 percent controlled by Bengang Group Co which is among China's top 10 steel makers, it said.

After the A share issue, Bengang Steel would have 1.196 billion outstanding shares, consisting of 616 million institutional shares held by Bengang Group, 460 million B shares and 120 million A shares.
